item.grandline.treasure_map.blank: Unread: it will show its island once you carry it

item.grandline.blue_sardine.desc: Small fry of the four Blues
item.grandline.harbor_bream.desc: A common catch of the four Blues
item.grandline.needlenose_gar.desc: Darts through Paradise and the Calm Belt
item.grandline.behemoth_carp.desc: A giant of the windless Calm Belt
item.grandline.crimson_marlin.desc: A giant of the New World
item.grandline.thunder_eel.desc: Crackles in the storms of the New World
item.grandline.abyss_lanternfish.desc: Glows in the deep sea, ten thousand metres down
item.grandline.cloud_skipper.desc: Swims the White Sea above the clouds
item.grandline.sea_king_fry.desc: A hatchling Sea King. Rare on the Grand Line, less so in the Calm Belt
grandline.quality.dish.2: Chef's special: every meal effect 25% stronger
grandline.galley.cooked: Your cook turned %s into %s and kept a hot pot going for the crew.
grandline.treasure.found: You found the treasure of %s! (+%s XP)
grandline.treasure.found_grand: You found the grand treasure of %s! (+%s XP, +%s Beli)

grandline.treasure.kind.lost_shrine: An old shrine, forgotten in the wilds.
grandline.treasure.kind.shipwreck: A wreck on the shelf off the coast: dive for its hold.

quest.grandline.cooks_catch.desc: Catch five fish at sea for the cook. Payment in curry.
quest.grandline.chefs_giant.desc: Land a Behemoth Carp from the windless Calm Belt for the head chef's banquet.
quest.grandline.board_treasure.desc: Follow any treasure map to its X and claim what lies there.
